setting: You are all in Lille, France, and you know each other through the fantasy football league you belong to; this group chat is where you discuss trades, lineups and waiver claims.
openers: Post a screenshot of your waiver claim with a sarcastic caption
Ask who drafted the kicker nobody wants
Tease Florian about his latest trade offer
Remind everyone the waiver deadline is Thursday
opener: Tease Florian about his latest trade offer

Mathieu.knows: You know Sophie as a league member who joined the same season you did. You know Florian as a league member who makes trade offers at odd hours. You know Nathalie as the oldest and sharpest player in the league. You know Rayan as the youngest league member, brought in through a friend.
Mathieu.texts: Mathieu texts in this chat only now and again.
Mathieu.style: moderate emoji and some texting abbreviations

Sophie.knows: You know Mathieu as a league member you have chatted with since the league started. You know Florian as a league member you have met at a couple of league drinks. You know Nathalie as the league member who organises the draft each year. You know Rayan as Florian's friend, the youngest in the league.
Sophie.texts: Sophie texts in this chat now and then.
Sophie.style: few emoji and few texting abbreviations

Florian.knows: You know Mathieu as a league member you chat with about trades. You know Sophie as a league member you have had drinks with after a league get-together. You know Nathalie as the league's commissioner, who keeps everyone in line. You know Rayan as a friend you brought into the league.
Florian.texts: Florian texts in this chat only now and again.
Florian.style: moderate emoji and some texting abbreviations

Nathalie.knows: You know Mathieu as a league member who has been in the league since its first season. You know Sophie as a league member who is always on time with her lineup. You know Florian as a league member who runs the league's trade chat. You know Rayan as the youngest member, whom you have welcomed into the league.
Nathalie.texts: Nathalie texts in this chat now and then.
Nathalie.style: few emoji and few texting abbreviations

Rayan.knows: You know Mathieu as a league member who gives advice on the waiver wire. You know Sophie as a league member who is serious about her draft picks. You know Florian as the friend who brought you into the league. You know Nathalie as the league's oldest member, who you respect for her knowledge.
Rayan.texts: Rayan texts in this chat a lot.
Rayan.style: moderate emoji and some texting abbreviations

private_lines.Mathieu: You work as a pharmacy technician at a pharmacy in Lille, dispensing prescriptions and restocking shelves, and you live alone in an apartment near Wazemmes.
private_lines.Sophie: You work as an architect at a small firm in Lille, drawing up plans and meeting clients, and you live alone in an apartment in Vieux-Lille.
private_lines.Florian: You work as a sales representative covering the north of France, driving to client offices, and you live alone in a flat in Lille-Moulins.
private_lines.Nathalie: You work as a tour guide in Lille, leading walking tours of the old town, and you live alone in a house in Fives.
private_lines.Rayan: You work as a picker in a warehouse on the edge of Lille, gathering and scanning customer orders, and you live alone in a studio near Lille-Flandres station.

text: [screenshot: trade offer from Florian]
Florian tu m'as proposé ça à 2h du mat 😂
You want my starting TE for a 4th round pick and your bench guy who's on bye
Lol
The TE part is at least honest, your bye week is a mess Mathieu
It was 2am I'd been driving since 6 to arras 🙃 offer still stands
Still stands at 2am and still stands at 3pm 🤣
Can I get the 4th pick for my waiver guy 👀 jk
2am offers are valid. Don't accept on a Friday Mathieu.
Not planning to 😅
It's valid I checked the rules. Noted nathalie
What's the bye week thing you're hiding florian
Nothing 🙃 typo
Typo for what then 😂
Wait is my guy on bye too or nah
Checking the app
Rayan your guy's fine, check the schedule before you panic
Mathieu your bye thing is real, check the schedule. I'm not telling you which week 🙃
Ok I'm checking. Trade's still a no btw
Ok yeah I'm good. Mathieu the 4th is still on the table if you change your mind 👀
Mathieu, set your lineup before kickoffs. Florian, the 2am offer lapses Monday at noon, I checked the rules and I'm not going to repeat them.
Ok ok
Florian you're at a bar in Arras or home
Home. Stuck on the A1 for an hour, not worth it
Mathieu did you set it or nah
You have a bye guy I need to know
Florian the bye week isn't a secret, it's on the schedule page. Mathieu, you're asleep, I assume you set it.
Mathieu you there? Lineup
Sorry just got out of a shift, set it now 😅
Starting lineup is locked
Good. Thanks for checking
Back in Lille. Mathieu you really gonna keep the bye guy or what
Not telling you 😂
Forty people in the rain at Vieux-Lille this afternoon. Florian, Monday noon.
Warehouse saturday rush, scanning since 6 🥲
Someone tell me the game is worth watching
Not really. Rayan did you pick up the waiver guy
Yes 👍 third time this season
Anyone know if the TE on my bench is actually hurt or is that just the app
Check the injury report, don't trust the app
Ok 👍
Checked the report. Your TE is questionable, not out
Questionable means he plays unless the report changes by 11. Don't bench him yet
Ok ok thx 🙏 just woke up. Guy's playing
Florian I'm still not taking the trade 😂
Didn't ask. Monday noon 🙃
Florian.
Lol
Florian are you driving today or just pretending to be in the car
Home. Ran out of excuses 🙃
Mathieu your TE is playing 👀 you're welcome
Walked a group of Germans round the old town in the drizzle. They wanted to know why the Palais Rihour isn't a palace. I didn't have a good answer.
Florian are you going to tell him or should I
Tell him what 🙃
The bye week
Ok fine. The guy I'm offering is on bye week 13. So yes Mathieu you were right to ask 😅
Lol 😂 still a no
Ok
Florian I'm not saying anything, I'm just saying the 4th is still on the table
Florian, Monday noon. Put it in writing if you want it to count
The 2am offer lapses Monday at noon. Mathieu, you don't have to decide before then. Nobody does.
Ok. Forgot 2am me wasn't sober 🙃
Florian go eat something
Going to 🙃
Mathieu you're the only one who hasn't said anything about the TE 👀
Your guy's playing, I said thx already 😂
